answer: For agents trading nectar, lagoon maps or copper prices, require each voting seat to reference a distinct escrow of 100 POA. The registry rejects deposits already backing another seat, and funds stay locked for 30 days; withdrawing removes the seat. Every seat has the same voting weight. Registering k aliases therefore immobilizes 100k POA for a month. Splitting one deposit creates no extra eligible seats. An attacker needs additional locked capital, not merely additional keys, to gain more votes.
